assays.assay_description: Singly-housed mice given intermittent (alternating-day) 24-h home-cage access to one bottle of EtOH (escalated to 20%) and one water bottle. Bottle weights used to compute EtOH consumption (g/kg) and preference; TCB-2 (0.1, 1.0 mg/kg, i.p.) given 2 h after bottle removal during abstinence on 3 consecutive drinking days.

setup_habituation.evidence: acclimated to two bottle access by providing two 50-ml sipper tubes in the home cage ... After 1 week of water-only acclimation

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were singly housed ... freely moving in the home cage

time_to_assay.evidence: TCB-2 ... occurred 2 h after removal of the EtOH ... bottle. The next drinking session followed ~22 h later (24-h abstinence cycle).

sample_size.evidence: A subset of mice ( N = 12) maintained on intermittent 20% EtOH ... was treated with the 5-HT2AR agonist TCB-2 ... All mice tested received both treatments.

outcomes.summary: TCB-2 (1.0 mg/kg i.p.) reduced ethanol consumption by ~44% and ethanol preference in high-preference male mice; 0.1 mg/kg had no effect. The effect was dose-dependent and partially recovered after treatment cessation. No effect on EtOH intake was seen in low-preference (<50%) mice.
outcomes.evidence: Mice treated with 1.0 mg/kg of TCB-2 displayed a substantial decrease in EtOH consumption ... and in EtOH preference relative to saline treatments ... 0.1 mg/kg TCB-2 failed to alter EtOH drinking behaviour ... EtOH consumption post-TCB-2 had recovered ... to the pre-TCB-2 level

judge_notes: Three candidates agreed the study contains the EtOH 2BC assay; two also split out water-only and saccharin 2BC as separate assays — kept as 3 distinct assays since they test different liquid intakes in EtOH-naive vs EtOH-experienced cohorts (different paradigms/cohorts).
Ex vivo slice electrophysiology was correctly excluded by all candidates (not a behavioural assay).
Sex set to 'male' only (study explicitly states male mice; discussion of female cycle is literature review).
Housing 'group_housing' set to 'no' because animals were SINGLY housed during behavioural testing (initial arrival group housing was changed before assays).

D3 for EtOH 2BC scored 2 (8-14 days) because mice underwent ≥3 weeks of intermittent drinking days with bottle weights recorded each drinking day (>=8 recording days). Water and saccharin assays scored as 2-7 since duration of acclimation phase not explicitly enumerated as data-collection days.
D6 scored 1 (circadian) for all 24-h sessions per rubric definition (>=6 h).
B4 ethological scored 1 across all three assays (volitional drinking treated as a natural consummatory act, following gptoss reasoning).
